description: KYNX v0.9.47 (Build 57) Zero-Lag Turbo Patch: Eliminated WebSocket double-emission (50% less CPU/recomposition), moved video thumbnail & disk image decoding strictly off the UI thread (butter-smooth 120Hz scrolling), fixed Watch Together WebView audio/RAM teardown, removed 400ms Send lockout for instant texting, fixed fast chat-switch race & optimistic ID sync, and optimized Web Deck adaptive polling.
